label: Intl Format
description: Locale-aware formatting nodes built on the browser's Intl APIs — no dependencies, no network. Relative Time turns a date into "3 hours ago" with an optional auto-refresh interval; Format Number handles decimal, currency and percent styles; Format List joins items with a localized conjunction or disjunction; Pluralize picks the right one/other form with Intl.PluralRules. Every node has a Locale input defaulting to the browser language, and every input is guarded — an unconnected input yields an empty string instead of throwing. NOT the part for formatting a date you already hold — "September 10th, 2026", "3:05 pm" — that is the format-date part, which wraps the Date To String node. This module formats against the clock and against number, list and plural rules; the two do not overlap and an app that shows a post date and a "posted 3 hours ago" beside it wants both.
